question: What is a relatively small, triangular-shaped minor oceanic plate located beneath the Pacific Ocean off the west coast of Central America?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cocos plate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Cocos Plate:

 
• Cocos plates lie between Central America and the Pacific Plate.
 
• The worldwide famous Coco Island rested upon it.
 
• The oceanic plate creates the Island chain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8238a6b09245afa2bdc95c3b230a2c1894c91e83981b04a66ca8f0cda5693ea.png] 

Thus, the Cocos Plate is located between Central America and the Pacific plate.&
